Chapter 420: Chapter 1: Galaxy Master (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 420: Chapter 1: Galaxy Master (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan was at the peak of the Sixth Rank, on the verge of breaking through to the Seventh Rank, when he completed the creation of his inner world.

Only by combining physical strength with soul strength, could one determine if an evolver has stepped into the Eighth Rank.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan squeezed out a drop of blood.

After dropping it into a metal bowl and getting confirmation from the emaciated staff member, Lin Yuan willed the drop of blood to dissipate into thin air.

Having mastered the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Blood Rebirth’, Lin Yuan had absolute control over every drop of his blood.

...

After verifying his physical body,

Lin Yuan proceeded to verify his soul strength.

Shortly thereafter,

the two staff members received confirmation.

The Peak Master of Shisan indeed stepped into the Eighth Rank.

Even during the confirmation, the two staff members speculated that the Peak Master of Shisan’s strength was far superior to that of a normal Eighth Rank evolver.

“Peak Master of Shisan,”

“we have finished the confirmation,”

the two staff members said with slight reverence.

“Thank you,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“May I ask if you, Peak Master, have decided on a name for the Star Domain you wish to preside over?” asked the emaciated staff member, slightly curious.

“A name?”

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment before saying, “I’ve already decided.”

“What is it?” the emaciated staff member asked curiously.

This was not exactly a secret; the name of a Star Domain would inevitably become public knowledge.

“Let’s call it ‘Milky Way’,” said Lin Yuan calmly, with a voice full of implication.

“Milky Way Star Region?”

“Milky Way?”

The two staff members, unaware of the significance of the name, congratulated with a smile, “Congratulations to the Galaxy Master on your new appointment.”

With the Star Domain named ‘Milky Way’, Lin Yuan naturally became the Galaxy Master.

“Galaxy Master…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts wandered.

He named the domain ‘Milky Way’ in remembrance of the galaxy that Earth belonged to before he crossed over to this Great Universe world.

…

After the two staff members left,

less than a minute passed,

Lin Yuan received the Goddess of Wisdom’s confirmation.

“Respected Seventh-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, your Star Domain application has passed the review,”

“please proceed to select the main star configuration,”

came the solemn and cool voice of the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Main star configuration?” Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow.

He knew about the main star, which was the most central location in a Star Domain, like the Chikun Main Star in the Chikun Star Domain.

“Respected Seventh-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, the so-called main star configuration is the selection of resource levels to remodel the main star,”

“Being a newly annexed Star Domain, the human civilization officially provides a Layer C remodel for free; once you confirm the main star, a designated evolver will go to remake it, granting it basic war capabilities…”

the Goddess of Wisdom explained.

“I see,”

Lin Yuan suddenly understood.

The Chikun Main Star, as the most prosperous place in the Chikun Star Domain, wouldn’t dare be messed with, even by Eighth Rank evolvers.

What accounted for this?

The Chikun Star Lord?

Not entirely.

Most of the time, the Chikun Star Lord was in seclusion, and other than the affairs atop the thirteen peaks, he typically ignored the rest.

What normally governed the Chikun Main Star were war technologies like the Planetary Defense System.

The Planetary Defense System on the Chikun Main Star could easily suppress any ordinary Eighth Rank evolver.

“What level of Planetary Defense System does a Layer C remodel correspond to?” Lin Yuan inquired.

“It can suppress all Sixth Rank powerhouses and most Seventh Rank powerhouses,” replied the Goddess of Wisdom.

“What about higher-level remodels?”

Lin Yuan continued to ask.

“A Layer B remodel can suppress all Seventh Rank powerhouses and most Eighth Rank powerhouses, and would require the Star Lord to pay an additional 100,000 Cubic Universe Crystals.”

“A Layer A remodel can suppress almost all Eighth Rank evolvers, with the exception of the invincibles, and would require the Star Lord to pay an additional one million Cubic Universe Crystals,”

the Goddess of Wisdom’s voice transmitted.

“So expensive?” Lin Yuan was somewhat taken aback; even a Layer B transformation required a hundred thousand Cosmic Crystals. What did that mean? It was equivalent to the entire wealth of a newly advanced Eighth Rank Evolver, including the value of treasures and weapons. Together, they amounted to just this much.

Not to mention a Layer A transformation.

But its effect was also obvious; a Layer B transformation could easily resolve most Eighth Rank Evolvers, and just this point alone was of immeasurable value.

“The main star of a star domain is the future economic and political center of that domain; there must be absolutely no security risks.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As long as the main star was well managed, it would become a money tree in the future. How much profit could the Chikun Main Star generate for the Chikun Star Lord, gathering merchants from numerous surrounding star domains each day?

“I choose the Layer B transformation,”

Lin Yuan said after some thought.

Whether it was a Layer B or a Layer A transformation, they were both ‘benefits’ provided by human civilization to various Star Lords.

A Planetary Defense System that could suppress most Eighth Rank powerhouses, if purchased privately, could not be quelled even with tens of thousands of Cubic Universe Crystals.

“Layer B transformation requires a hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals… Respected Seventh-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, please confirm…” the voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came.

“Confirmed.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The next moment,

his account balance was short by a hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

“It’s deducted so quickly?” Lin Yuan felt a bit of heartache; a hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals left in his account a while longer would have earned tens of millions of Civilization Currency in interest.

“Really can’t resist spending this money…” Lin Yuan sighed.

After the Eighth Rank celebratory ceremony, Lin Yuan’s total wealth once reached nearly two hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

Now, it had shrunk by more than half all at once.

“It can be earned back in the future.”

“As long as the safety of the main star isn’t compromised, it will inevitably become an economic center of a star domain. Wouldn’t it be easy to recoup the investment by then?”

Lin Yuan comforted himself internally.

These were all initial investments; given a choice, Lin Yuan would have even preferred a Layer A transformation.

…

After the choice of star domain was approved,

Lin Yuan did not return to the great hall.

Instead, he went directly to the vermilion palace where the Chikun Star Lord was in seclusion.

“Teacher.”

At the palace, Lin Yuan bowed slightly to the Chikun Star Lord.

Even now, as Lin Yuan had stepped into the Eighth Rank, he still felt an overwhelming sense of pressure when facing the Chikun Star Lord.

One must know, although Lin Yuan had just entered the Eighth Rank, with the help of his Inner World, he was enough to battle late Eighth Rank, or even Peak Eighth Rank Evolvers.

“Is this what it means to be invincible among the Eighth Rank? To have mastered a type of Cosmic Force?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Each invincible Eighth Rank had mastered a power that reigned supreme over Eighth Rank.

This power was also known as ‘Cosmic Force.’

In essence, the invincible Eighth Rank still remained at the Fourth Stage of the Eighth Rank, which is the extreme of the Eighth Rank.

However, in terms of combat power, an invincible Eighth Rank could almost crush the extreme Eighth Rank. A million years ago, an invincible member of the Heiyuan Clan, Black Abyss Qingyu, killed Ou Yin, who was in the late Eighth Rank, with a single soul attack.

Each invincible Eighth Rank was unique, and the Cosmic Force they mastered was different from one another.

“My good disciple, have you made your choice of star domain?” The Chikun Star Lord looked at Lin Yuan with a smile.

Among the thirteen disciples, the one who gave him the least worry was Lin Yuan, who also had the highest achievements to date.

It was foreseeable that in the future, it would still be Lin Yuan.

“Teacher, I’ve made my choice,” Lin Yuan replied.

He then took out a map and marked out that particular star domain.

“There, huh…

“Not bad.”

The Chikun Star Lord nodded and said.

“When going to the Fringe Starfield, be very careful. By the way, you must have met the Supreme Being, right?” Suddenly, the Chikun Star Lord asked.

If it was merely an under a hundred-year-old Seventh Rank, the Supreme Being might not take much notice, but for an under a hundred-year-old Eighth Rank, the Chikun Star Lord was almost certain it would draw the attention of a Supreme Being.

“Teacher, the Supreme Being I met was Xia Qin Supreme Being,”

Lin Yuan said.

There was no need to hide this matter. How could the historically ranked top twenty or top ten genius Evolvers of human civilization have not met with a Supreme Being?

“Xia Qin Supreme Being… That’s a Supreme Being known for combat power in our human civilization,” the Chikun Star Lord spoke.

Human civilization has nine Supreme Beings.

Each Supreme Being excels in different areas.

To be precise, the Supreme Beings have no weak points, but compared to other Supreme Beings, they have their areas of advantage.

For instance, the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, although not skilled in direct combat, has followed an Evolution Path that allows her to construct an illusory universe.

The current Virtual World of human civilization originates from the ‘authority’ of the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, nearly able to flawlessly replicate everything within the universe, even simulating the rules.

The importance of the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being is in no way inferior to that of the Xia Qin Supreme Being.
